title: The Infinite Aisle of the Single-Source Almond
core_theme: The vertigo of choosing between identical iterations of capital.
narrative_spec: Examine choice and the immense amounts of pure decisions that are made... capture that gravity and harness it in your Poem.

title: Litany for the 4:18 PM Gridlock
core_theme: The collective mass isolation of the highway commute.
narrative_spec: Set during a standstill traffic jam on an eight-lane highway infrastructure. Can you work this into a beleivable society of souls?

title: The Taxonomy of the Terms of Service Agreement
core_theme: The bureaucratic surrender of the immortal soul.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct the physical act of scrolling through an endless, unread digital software agreement to check an 'I Agree' box on a phone.

title: The Geometry of the Loading Circle
core_theme: The confrontation with infinity through internet latency.
narrative_spec: Focus entirely on the spinning gray or white buffering wheel on a dark television screen during a streaming failure. Reframe this micro-delay.

title: The Oracle of the Self-Checkout Scanner
core_theme: The validation of human physical existence by a laser beam.
narrative_spec: Speak on the public humiliation brought about by automation, or the lack of humanity in a space you value

title: The Protocol of the Office Birthday Card
core_theme: The performative execution of mandatory corporate intimacy.
narrative_spec: How does a corporate workspace make you feel? In theory, in reality, in purgatory

title: The Calculus of the Unassembled Swedish Desk
core_theme: The breakdown
narrative_spec: Examine a renovation or restoration

title: The 3:00 AM Wikipedia Descent
core_theme: The gluttonous consumption of disparate human knowledge.
narrative_spec: Gamification of life - where in your existance are you looking or already existing within a gamified version of reality?

title: The Epistemology of the Missing Sock
core_theme: The localized violation of the conservation of matter.
narrative_spec: Reframe any minor household annoyance into a terrifying crack in physical reality

title: The Anatomy of the CAPTCHA Test
core_theme: The irony of a human proving their humanity to an algorithm.
narrative_spec: Can you extract meaning enough for a poem derived from the experience of the login page of ANY website?

title: The Sovereignty of the Waiting Room Fish Tank
core_theme: The parallel containment of biological specimens.
narrative_spec: Set in the liminal spaces encouraged onto us by the joy of waiting rooms. move the audience with you through this space.

title: The Dialectics of the Junk Mail Cascade
core_theme: The relentless physical accumulation of dead tree advertisements.
narrative_spec: I want to understand how you feel about mail... the USPS, the weight of paper.

title: The Last French Fry in the Paper Bag
core_theme: The cold calculation of grease and salt residue.
narrative_spec: Focus on the physical discovery of a cold, solitary fry sitting at the bottom of a fast-food bag on a car passenger seat. Use sensory details of translucent grease on brown paper. Reframe this object as a pathetic, salty monument to the speaker's nutritional choices and the fleeting nature of cheap dopamine hits.

title: The Metric of the Unreturned Tupperware
core_theme: The social debt stored in cheap domestic plastic.
narrative_spec: Examine a kitchen cabinet filled with mismatched plastic food containers and lids that do not fit. Unpayable social debt, no cap.      *BANG*

title: The Interrogation of the Smart Thermostat
core_theme: The technological optimization of human comfort boundaries.
narrative_spec: A speaker tries to adjust the temperature in their apartment, take into account the luxury of this environmental control. let those emotions bleed onto the page.

title: The Sinking Index of the Treadmill Screen
core_theme: The absurdity of running in place on a digital earth.
narrative_spec: The gym is like hell to me, why not flex the greatest muscle we have... our minds... just kidding, write about the gym, inspire me to learn to lift.

title: The Protocol of the Office Water Cooler Gurgle
core_theme: The auditory punctuation of administrative silence.
narrative_spec: how does the ambiance of a space affect your mood... like really get into it. Are you peeved or soothed?

title: The Taxonomy of the Unused Excel Row
core_theme: The digitization of human potential into infinite grid coordinates.
narrative_spec: The digital void and unfounded wisdom of a well executed excel sheet. Shareholder value? Hell yea

title: The Litany of the Hotel Key Card De-magnetization
core_theme: The sudden mechanical exile from a temporary home.
narrative_spec: I LOVE HOTEL Carpets... make me FEEL something about them... i want to live within them and understand them on a spiritual level

title: The Calibration of the Automatic Air Freshener
core_theme: The synthetic masking of organic existence.
narrative_spec: Set in a public restroom where a white plastic box on the wall emits a sudden, high-pressure hiss of fragrance every nine minutes, regardless of who is in the room. Is the machine a savior?

title: The Architecture of the Lost Remote Control
core_theme: The dependency of domestic narrative on an plastic brick.
narrative_spec: you have lost something not so dear to you... but its absence is not possible to live with

title: The Elevator's Weight Mirror
core_theme: The confrontation with the aging face in a moving box.
narrative_spec: A person rides an elevator alone down thirty floors in a steel skyscraper. thats it... make this poem MOVE me

title: The Last Item in the Online Shopping Cart
core_theme: The preservation of desire through unexecuted commerce.
narrative_spec: An analysis of an online digital cart that has contained a specific odd item or two
